# goslop text fixture (.txt) — materialized to .py at test/runtime
# Password / auth integrity still uses weak MD5 and must remain reportable.
lang: python
file: CWE-328-fingerprint-vulnerable.py
---
import hashlib


def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.md5(password.encode()).hexdigest()


def auth_token_digest(token: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha1(token.encode()).hexdigest()
